purpose: Verify the DSCSA T3 set (Transaction Information + History + Statement) completeness, validate the GS1 SGTIN, and map the EPCIS 2.0 event type. Feeds the saleable-returns verifier (art-113). DSCSA §582: enforcement live since Aug 2025.
